month.lede: Three shifts a day (sorting, packing, deliveries), closed on Sundays. Free places are shown on each day.

help.lede: Shifts run morning, afternoon and evening, Monday to Saturday.

help.day: Nobody does two shifts on the same day.
help.past: Past dates are a record and cannot be edited.
help.withdraw: Helpers drop out of a shift from their own page, which frees the place.
